cards.answer: Mordekaiser is a fighter and mage with AP scaling and sustained nearby magic damage. He pulls enemies into reach and can isolate a champion in the Death Realm while stealing their stats.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance, sidestep his pull, and avoid prolonged close combat.

cards.answer: His basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Attacks and basic abilities against champions or large monsters build stacks; at full stacks, he gains movement speed and a nearby magic damage aura that scales with enemies' maximum health. The aura's damage alone does not refresh its duration.
cards.counterplay: Disengage from his aura and limit continued attacks or ability hits.

cards.counterplay: Move out of the targeted area and look for an opening after he misses the pull.

cards.answer: Realm of Death slows and reveals a target champion during its cast, then confines them with Mordekaiser in a separate arena where other champions cannot follow or interact with them. He heals and temporarily steals combat stats from the target; if the target dies inside, he keeps the stolen stats until they respawn. A spell shield or crowd control immunity can prevent the banishment during the cast, but applying them after entry does not undo it.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance when isolation would be dangerous; inside the realm, prioritize survival and evade his attacks.

citations.quote: slowing them by 75% and revealing them over the cast time, and then banishing them with him to the Death Realm

Units between realms see each other as spirits, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between each other.
